bin_threshold_meaning: Cumulative recorded bins per pair in each window, not consecutive contact or precisely measured continuous seconds.
community_comparison: Independent partitions per window; aggregate overlap lineage is algorithmic membership overlap, not observed social fission/merger.
cross_group_partition: Freeze the primary first-window partition for all windows and scenarios; separately report edges touching its zero-record nodes and edges between its nonzero-record nodes.
endpoint_rule: start < t <= end for each 20-second endpoint t; all window endpoints align with the source grid
graph: simple undirected unit topology; counts are reported separately and not converted to distances

group.selection: original NetworkX greedy prominent_group on the full-archive graph, once
group.unsupported_scope: NOT_RUN; never silently drop zero-record nodes or take a connected subset

measurement_scope: Recorded badge proximity bins, not complete physical contact, conversation, friendship, trust or conflict.
outcomes: fixed-baseline cross-community counts and pair turnover
static reachable pair fraction and mean other nodes reachable
population_scope: Fixed retrospective union of all anonymous IDs in the provided published artifact, including zero-record nodes; not all conference attendees or an independently observed roster.
public_output: Aggregate counts, metrics and reproducibility fingerprints only; no badge IDs, pair lists or community memberships.
question: How do recorded cross-community contacts, static reachability and the same retrospective reference group differ between two equal calendar windows?
uncertainty_scope: No sampling confidence interval, missing-sensor imputation, causal identification or forecast qualification. The two sensitivity specifications do not validate unknown recording coverage.
